odvs.description: win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic is This policy setting allows the auditing of outgoing NTLM traffic. Events for this setting are recorded in the operational event log (e.g. Applications and Services Log\Microsoft\Windows\NTLM). The recommended state for this setting is: Audit all. Configuring this setting to Deny All also conforms to the benchmark. Note: Configuring this setting to Deny All is more secure, however it could have a negative impact on applications that still require NTLM. Test carefully before implementing the Deny All value. 7.26.24 - CIS documentation is incorrect stating that audit all is 2. CIS has a fix in the works and that is already applied here. Note: Possible Valid Settings 1 - Audit All 2 - Deny All
odvs.name: restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.11.12 | PATCH | Ensure 'Network security: Restrict NTLM: Outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers' is set to 'Audit all' or higher'"
  when: win11cis_rule_2_3_11_12
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.11.12
    - ntlm
    - NIST800-171_3.3.1
    - NIST800-171_3.3.2
    - NIST800-171_3.3.6
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-12
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-7
  block:
    - name: "2.3.11.12 | PATCH | Ensure 'Network security: Restrict NTLM: Outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers' is set to 'Audit all' or higher' | Set Variable"
      when: win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic == 1 or win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic == 2
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\System\Currentcontrolset\Control\Lsa\Msv1_0
        name: RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic
        data: "{{ win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "2.3.11.12 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Network security: Restrict NTLM: Outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers' is set to 'Audit all' or higher' | Warning Check For Variable"
      when:
        - win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic != 1
        - win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic != 2
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid variable set for win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.11.12 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Network security: Restrict NTLM: Outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers' is set to 'Audit all' or higher' | Warn Count"
      when:
        - win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic != 1
        - win11cis_restrict_sending_ntlm_traffic != 2
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.11.12'
